stem: A 2-week promotion gave Earbuds Pro X 120 extra units, and the sister earbuds lost 120 units: a cannibalisation rate of 100%. Which conclusion does this support?

options.text: The promotion lost money, since the category sold no extra units
The deal moved earbuds sales between products without adding units
Pro X's promo uplift was 100% against its own baseline
Pro X's extra buyers would otherwise have bought from a rival store
